resources.string:
IOKey is a privacy-first keyboard with a tiny on-device language model.

• Your typing stays on this phone
• IOKey goes online to download the models you choose, including voice models and links you add, and you can switch that off
• Learns your writing style locally
• Encrypted on-device storage
• No analytics or accounts of its own

The Play version also includes Google Play's billing library, which talks to Google Play and sends its own diagnostics to Google. IOKey gives it no typed text.
